caption: The drawing depicts a cylindrical lantern made of metallic material with a dark blue-to-black coloration. The body and conical top of the lantern are decorated with a repeating pattern of orange circular and linear perforations arranged in radiating and swirling patterns. There is a circular handle affixed to the apex of the conical top, and a small orange dot is also present on the top portion of the lantern. A rectangular hinged door with a latch is visible on the front of the lantern. The background of the image is plain, off-white, and unadorned. The artist’s signature, "David S. De Vault," is inscribed in the lower right corner.
title: Tin Lantern
cluster: #16 — Lighting Devices: Lamps, Lanterns, and Candleholders
